read.thesis: Gas Power slot-reservation and backlog conversion lifted orders to $29.3B (+96% organic) and 2026 guidance was raised on revenue, margin and FCF, with Gas backlog plus slots at 122 GW heading to 130 GW.

capex.quote: Invested $0.6 billion in capital expenditures, including to increase production in Power and Electrification, as part of its commitment to invest $6 billion in capex from 2025 through 2028

triggers.label: Power segment EBITDA margin 21.4%
triggers.quote: favorable price and higher volume at Gas Power, partially offset by the impact of inflation

triggers.label: FCF guide raised to $16-17B
triggers.quote: free cash flow* of $16-$ 17 billion, up from $11.5-$12.5 billion

triggers.label: Gas slot reservations 116→122 GW
triggers.quote: Gas Power equipment backlog and slot reservation agreements grew from 116 to 122 GW; now anticipate reaching at least 130 GW by year-end 2026

triggers.label: Orders +96% organic to $29.3B
triggers.quote: In the quarter, orders of $29.3 billion increased +96% organically

guidance.quote: now expects revenue of $46.5-$47.5 billion, up from $45.5-$46.5 billion
adjusted EBITDA margin* of 13.5%-14.5%, up from 12%-14%
free cash flow* of $16-$ 17 billion, up from $11.5-$12.5 billion
Organic revenue* down mid-single digits, versus prior guidance of down low-double digits
now anticipate reaching at least 130 GW by year-end 2026
We now expect our backlog to exceed $200 billion in the fourth quarter

red_flags.label: Q3 FCF boosted by working-capital benefit
red_flags.quote: primarily due to higher positive benefits from working capital and stronger adjusted EBITDA

red_flags.label: Electrification orders down 9% organically
red_flags.quote: $5.4 billion decreased (9)% organically, given large synchronous condenser orders
